resources.string: Detects short-form video feeds so only those can be slowed down
Reels, Shorts and Spotlight only — everything else is at full speed
Do something kind and log it — worth 10 minutes of clear time.
%1$d days running. One small kindness keeps it going.
Nice. %1$d clear minutes added — your feeds run at full speed until they are spent.
Nicely done. You are already at today\'s clear-time ceiling.

ORBIS needs this to tell which screen you are on inside an app — for example Instagram Reels versus Instagram Stories. Only Reels, Shorts and Spotlight are ever slowed; Stories, messages and normal videos are left alone. ORBIS reads screens only in the apps it targets, keeps everything on your device, and never sends anything anywhere.
